name: Sequencer integration guides
description:
Step-by-step guides for connecting Infrabox mailboxes to each sequencer Infrabox actually supports. Every slug maps 1:1 to a platform listed at /sequencers/connect. Zero tolerance for hallucinated integrations.

An earlier run of this cluster hallucinated integrations for Apollo, Hunter, and HeyReach. Apollo is in the metadata file but hidden from the public UI; Hunter and HeyReach are not in Infrabox's sequencer codebase at all. The Apollo article was rolled back and the rules below now prevent a recurrence.

authoritativeSource._note: Before drafting ANY slug in this cluster, the worker MUST read both of these files. They are the canonical list of supported sequencers — anything not in sequencer-metadata.ts is NOT supported, period.
authoritativeSource.rule: Every sequencer mentioned in a draft must match a platform key in sequencerMetadata object. Every feature claimed must come from the features array in that platform's metadata entry or from the sequencer's own docs. No inventing fields, caps, or flows.

headKeywords: how to import infrabox mailboxes into <sequencer>
intentHints: The Infrabox dashboard has a /sequencers/connect page that handles the actual connection UI. Workers should reference what that page actually does (from the source in authoritativeSource) — the connection fields, the validation flow, the workspace selection, the tags — rather than inventing a generic flow.

featuredAssets._note: Use library assets — do NOT re-capture Infrabox UI via Playwright. The sequencers.png screenshot shows the Infrabox Sequencers page with the actual connected/available platforms list.

variables.note: SendKit has a special flow in page.tsx — workspace info is fetched after API key validation and requires Google/Microsoft OAuth configured in SendKit. Reference lines 1708-1761 in ../src/app/(dashboard)/sequencers/connect/page.tsx for the real validation flow.

notes:
ZERO HALLUCINATION POLICY:

1. Before drafting any slug, the worker MUST read ../src/lib/sequencer-metadata.ts and confirm the platformKey exists. If it does not, STOP and log a gap.

2. The worker MUST also read ../src/lib/sequencers.ts to confirm the sequencer has an active form config. If the metadata has it but sequencers.ts does not (e.g. LeadsPicker, ReachInbox may be metadata-only), the connection may not be live yet — verify by checking ../src/app/(dashboard)/sequencers/connect/page.tsx for rendering logic. If not live, skip and log to gaps.json with reason='metadata-only-no-form-config'.

3. The worker MUST reference the EXACT connection fields defined in sequencers.ts for each platform. No inventing 'the integration needs a webhook URL' when the real flow is email+password. If in doubt, check the connection panel rendering in page.tsx.

4. Screenshots: use /images/dashboard/sequencers.png for any screenshot of the Infrabox sequencers list. Do NOT re-capture via Playwright. If you need a screenshot of the target sequencer's UI and none exists in public/images/, run /seo-scrape <sequencer-domain> to capture a home/pricing shot — but only the sequencer's OWN site, not the Infrabox connect panel with that sequencer selected (which would require an authenticated session).

5. Excluded slugs include the 3 already-shipped integration articles (instantly, smartlead, lemlist) from the earlier run. Do NOT regenerate them. Do read them for voice reference.

6. Apollo-specific: Apollo exists as a platform key in sequencer-metadata.ts but is NOT in the public /sequencers/connect UI (not in the user-facing 24-item catalog). The Apollo integration article was previously hallucinated and rolled back. DO NOT draft an Apollo integration article from this cluster. Apollo remains a valid subject for /alternatives/apollo and for third-party comparisons, but NOT for an 'infrabox-apollo-integration' guide.

7. Voice reference: re-read infrabox-instantly-integration.js, infrabox-smartlead-integration.js, infrabox-lemlist-integration.js before drafting to mirror the voice and structure exactly.
